fields.description:
A runaway/exhaustion-truncated completion-verifier run is dispositioned as a BLOCKING
substantive FAIL (exit 1, requires --force) instead of the non-blocking, re-runnable
INDETERMINATE fault the contract requires (bug 2a6f; 46a2; ed6d). Root cause confirmed
(see RCA comment): two compounding seams downstream of a correctly-firing runaway guard,
both introduced by ticket 1d71-a76c-04f6-4642 (commit 6b318ffaec4a).

## Root cause (proven)
- Seam A (mint): `completion_verdict_assembly._restamp_marker` stamps the insufficiency
  marker only when the criterion's BANK entry carries it; a truncated criterion is never
  banked (`entry is None`) so the marker is POPPED, minting a bare `met=false`
  indistinguishable from a positive refutation.
- Seam B (disposition): `completion_reconcile.reconcile_verdict` sets top-level
  `evidence_sufficient=False` on an insufficiency-only FAIL but not `verdict_obtainable=False`;
  the close gate's `_raise_on_verifier_fault` (close_precheck.py:402) and the standalone
  `verify-completion` verb (_llm_commands.py:276) take the retryable exit-11 path ONLY on
  `verdict_obtainable is False`, so a clean insufficiency-only FAIL still hard-blocks (exit 1).

## Approach (two behavior-preserving fixes, reuse existing seams)
- Fix A — `completion_verdict_assembly.merge_finalizer_with_bank`/`_restamp_marker`: on a
  finalizer echo, a `met=false` record for a criterion with NO conclusive bank entry
  (un-evaluated / truncated) is stamped `evidence_sufficient=False` (insufficiency), not
  popped. A conclusive bank entry (evidence gathered, no insufficiency marker) is still
  honored as a genuine refutation — genuine failures are NOT masked.
- Fix B — `completion_reconcile.reconcile_verdict`: when `_insufficiency_only(result)` is
  True, also set `verdict_obtainable=False`, routing through the EXISTING exit-11 retryable
  fault path (bug 2a6f). No `close_precheck` change; reuses the existing `verdict_obtainable`
  marker already documented in completion_verdict.schema.json and consumed identically by both
  the close gate and the standalone verb (caller sweep: both already map it to exit 11).

## Impacted sites
- src/rebar/llm/workflow/completion_verdict_assembly.py — `_restamp_marker`,
  `merge_finalizer_with_bank` (un-banked `met=false` -> insufficiency, guarded on
  truncation/no-conclusive-entry).
- src/rebar/llm/completion_reconcile.py — `reconcile_verdict` final insufficiency-only block
  sets `verdict_obtainable=False`.
- tests/ — new deterministic regression tests (no LLM).

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A runaway/exhaustion-truncated verdict whose unmet criteria are all evidence-insufficient
  (including un-banked `met=false` echoes) reconciles with `verdict_obtainable=False` and the
  close gate raises the retryable exit 11 (NOT exit 1); the ticket does not close.
- [ ] A completed run with a genuinely-refuted criterion (met=false WITH conclusive bank
  evidence, no insufficiency marker) still blocks with exit 1 — genuine failures are not
  masked (dual assertion).
- [ ] `merge_finalizer_with_bank` stamps `evidence_sufficient=False` on an un-banked
  `met=false` finalizer echo rather than popping the marker.
- [ ] Deterministic regression tests (no LLM) cover all three; `make lint` + `make typecheck`
  clean; per-function complexity ratchet not increased.

## Portability
No CI-provider coupling: the fix is pure in-process verdict reconciliation/assembly logic,
exercised by deterministic unit tests that run under any/no CI provider.

## Test plan
Held-out RED oracle drives `reconcile_verdict` + `merge_finalizer_with_bank` on synthetic
verdict/bank dicts (the reproducer's proven harness); asserts the exit-11 disposition and the
non-masking dual case; mutation-check by restoring the pop/omission.
